name: Hampi

sample_attractions.description: 7th-century functioning temple dedicated to Lord Shiva with towering 50m gopuram.

sample_attractions.title: Vijaya Vittala Temple & Stone Chariot
sample_attractions.description: Iconic musical pillars and the world-famous stone chariot monolith.

sample_attractions.title: Matanga Hill Sunrise Trek
sample_attractions.description: Panoramic sunrise viewpoint overlooking the boulders and ruins across Tungabhadra river.

short_description: The cultural capital of Karnataka renowned for its royal heritage, silk weaving, sandalwood, and grand palace.

sample_attractions.title: Devaraja Market Walking Tour
sample_attractions.description: Century-old vibrant market full of fresh flowers, Mysore betel leaves, perfumes, and spices.

sample_attractions.title: Abbey Falls & Coffee Estate Walk

sample_attractions.title: Raja's Seat Sunset Pavilion

sample_attractions.title: Namdroling Golden Temple (Bylakuppe)

sample_attractions.title: Mahabaleshwar Temple

sample_attractions.title: Kudle Beach Sunset & Beach Shack Cafe

sample_attractions.title: Coffee Plantation Heritage Tour

sample_attractions.title: Aihole Durga Temple Complex

sample_attractions.description: Float along the riverbanks to observe marsh crocodiles, otters, and aquatic birds.
